column7: AssignUserRole and every other grant-shaped security mutation (role/group/permission/role-definition grants, group membership, break-glass activation, access-request approval, shares, secret ACLs, machine identities/tokens/roles, PATs, user/project/environment create, SoD policies) committed first and appended its audit row afterwards through c.storage or the transport, so a crash or a refused append between the two left a grant with no audit record (REVIEW-1). AUDIT-TX-2 writes the rows through the transaction-scoped store as the last statements of the mutation's transaction (withAuditedMutation) and returns their failure, so the change rolls back. Red on main: 84/84 error, effect-then-error, panic and crash-at-append cases (21 kinds); green after on SQLite and PostgreSQL.
